svg.aria-label: Flea glyph specimen, the Omarchy cut
svg.text: Lucide's 24 unit grid and metrics, square caps, mitered joins, no rounded corner anywhere.
The spiral at left is the brand mark: empty state, loading crawl, transfers. Rows never draw it.
69 marks ship today, one per entry in ui/js/Icons.js. Base geometry from lucide 1.38.0 (ISC), recut.
